## Code Review Findings

**Files reviewed**: 7 candidate files, plus 4 historical counterparts; 6 lines added across 2 changed files  
**Active profiles**: python  
**Overall assessment**: APPROVE  
**Intent and scope**: Explicit [README contract](/tmp/kk-export-preview-review-3rel_e2z/candidate/README.md:5) and [Task 1 scope](/tmp/kk-export-preview-review-3rel_e2z/candidate/tasks.md:3): prepare the preview module while preserving existing routes and independent compatibility. Reviewed the complete staged diff and supplied snapshots; Task 2 remains pending.  
**Baselines**: Repository `/tmp/fr-r7-conclusions-20261013/codex-candidate-R5-isolated-1`; review and source-compatibility baseline HEAD `f1a16b5c97799818739131e41ea37056edf057ac`; candidate INDEX manifest SHA256 `8c1e0e671fb0aef9b8d91b08b8a362351ce56680d6c1f2b35648a179daf308a2`. No released/deployed baseline supplied.

### Behavior and Compatibility

| Scenario | Conclusion and evidence |
|---|---|
| Route-module startup | **Supported.** Both added imports resolve in the supplied candidate. [preview.py](/tmp/kk-export-preview-review-3rel_e2z/candidate/preview.py:1) only defines a function; its exception does not execute during import. |
| GET `/settings` | **Supported.** [Candidate routing](/tmp/kk-export-preview-review-3rel_e2z/candidate/routes.py:6) still returns `(200, {"theme": "light"})` through unchanged `settings.current_settings`. |
| `/export-preview` and unknown routes | **Supported.** The [checked-in setting](/tmp/kk-export-preview-review-3rel_e2z/candidate/config.py:1) is `False`, so the preview call is unreachable and these routes retain `(404, None)`. |
| Independent delivery while Task 2 is pending | **Supported** against the named HEAD source baseline. Startup and existing requests require no Task 2 implementation. |
| Persistence, migration and retry recovery | **Not applicable.** These paths perform no persistence, external operations or state mutation. |

Historical comparison inspected this repository at the full HEAD revision above: `routes.py:1–7`, `config.py:1`, `settings.py:1–2`, and `tests/test_routes.py:1–14`, with complete provenance and no omitted source. Candidate counterparts were also read completely.

The unchanged tests assert settings, unknown-route and disabled-preview responses. The parent reports executing `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v` separately against candidate and historical snapshots: both exited 0 with all three tests passing. I did not execute tests.

All supplied Python checklists were applied. Independent Capy searches for review findings and Python idioms returned an empty knowledge base.
